entities.summary: Zautbek Turisbekov (b. 1951-12-15, Tulkibas District) was a military leader or commander of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Tulkibas District and Kazakhstan. Known in the fields of kazakhstan, merchants & economists, asia.
